source.name: The Daily Tribune (Bahrain), 'Victorious Bahrain goes European: Shaikh Nasser visits Paris FC'
source.quote: visited the headquarters of French club Paris FC, which competes under the banner of “Victorious Bahrain”
source.note: The club's official partners page lists Team Bahrain Victorious first under 'Partenaires principaux' (main partners); the shirt photo on the club's shop shows BAHRAIN VICTORIOUS printed across the centre chest.

source.name: Paris FC — Nos partenaires (Google Pixel appears under Partenaires majeurs)
source.quote: Partenaires principaux Partenaires majeurs Partenaires officiels et institutionnels Fournisseurs Officiels
source.note: The partner names on that page are images; Google Pixel's logo (alt 'Google Pixel') sits under the heading 'Partenaires majeurs'. Wikipedia's 2026-27 Ligue 1 kit table (uncited) places Google Pixel on the front of the shirt.

source.name: Paris FC — adidas et le Paris FC dévoilent le maillot domicile pour la saison 26-27
source.quote: adidas et le Paris FC présentent aujourd’hui le nouveau maillot domicile pour la saison 2026/27.
source.note: Kit maker, named by the club in the kit launch; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: Adidas kit. Bahrain Victorious (Bahrain state brand) across the centre chest, Google Pixel on the front, Vinci on the back, Renault on the sleeves, Bwin on the shorts.
